<a name="Service"></a>
## type [Service](<https://github.com/effective-security/trustyca/blob/main/server/service/ui/ui_service.go#L21-L24>)

Service serves the static test pages: the ALIVE index, the login page that starts the OAuth flow, the page shown after authentication, and the Stripe checkout page. The pages are embedded in the binary and rendered with the public keys \(reCAPTCHA site key, Stripe publishable key\) taken from the configuration.
